verdict.rationale: 2FAS's homepage lists 'Apple Watch' as a product feature for 'improved convenience and accessibility', which points to a first-party watch surface for 2FAS Auth. It is only a single marketing line and does not say that codes can be viewed on the watch without the phone. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that TOTP codes display on the watch, whether it works independently of the phone, any Wear OS or Android smartwatch support, setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone

citations.quote: Apple Watch Improved convenience and accessibility.
